mentions.name: DateIt
mentions.description: This app is an event planning app for iOS, Android, and the web with features including calendar sync, photo upload, posts/comments/reactions, recurring events, SMS notifications, and a greeting card maker. Most features are free with a fair pricing model.
mentions.problem: The builders wanted to capture the "facebook events" experience without Facebook, starting the project during the Covid lockdown.
mentions.source_excerpt:
My friends and I have been hacking on http://dateit.com for a while.
